meta.title: First Things First
meta.instructions: Two moments from history, from different worlds. Tap the one that happened first. A wrong call costs a life; streaks score extra.

quiz_questions.body: if locked and len(opts) > 0 then content_notes else map(content_notes, n => 'Which came first?')

score.measures: points for pairs put in the right order, with a streak bonus

art.style: A museum timeline at night: deep green walls, brass labels, tick marks of centuries along the edges.

notes: Oxford was teaching by 1096. Tenochtitlan was founded in 1325, over 200 years later.
Alexander Bain patented a fax in 1843. Bell’s telephone patent came in 1876.
The pyramid went up around 2560 BC. Mammoths lived on Wrangel Island until about 2000 BC.
Nintendo began making playing cards in 1889. The Model T arrived in 1908.
Sliced bread was first sold in 1928. Pluto was spotted in 1930.
Harvard opened in 1636. Calculus took shape in the 1660s to 1680s.
Star Wars opened in May 1977. France’s last guillotine execution was that September.
The Tube opened in 1863. The Tokugawa shogunate fell in 1868.
Döbereiner’s lighter dates from 1823. The friction match came in 1826.
The Diners Club card launched in 1950. Hillary and Tenzing summited in 1953.
Ray Tomlinson sent email in 1971. The first handheld cellphone call was in 1973.
John Logie Baird demonstrated television in 1926. Fleming found penicillin in 1928.
Stegosaurus lived about 150 million years ago, T. rex about 68. T. rex is closer in time to us.
KDKA in Pittsburgh went on air in 1920. The Ottoman sultanate was abolished in 1922.
